filter.comment: Episode = take dir (~1101, some still extracting). File prefix inside channels is 'Nymeria_v0.0_<take>_<suffix>', NOT the bare take name. recording_observer/ and semidense_observations/ are ignored (ego = recording_head).

params.scale_to_mp4: multiply output px by mp4_width/2880 (ffprobe mp4 W per take; preview is a uniform downscale, square, no display-matrix rotation)
params.device_cad: DeviceCadExtrinsics(Gen1, 'DVT-S', 'camera-slam-left'); DeviceCalibration cameras from online_calibration.jsonl CameraCalibrations[] (T_Device_Camera quat+translation, Projection.Params).
params.depth: use per-sample depth_m (vs fixed 1.0 shifts ~60px); yaw=mean(left_yaw,right_yaw), pitch=pitch_rads_cpf
params.out_of_fov: fn returns None when gaze leaves FOV -> emit null gaze for that frame
params.calib_pick: use the online_calibration.jsonl line whose tracking_timestamp_us is nearest the target gaze ts (~1Hz calib)

projection.time_sync: device_ts_us(frame i) = first_gaze_ts_us + round(i * 1e6 / mp4_fps); first_gaze_ts_us = first eye_gaze.csv row tracking_timestamp_us; gaze 30Hz, preview mp4 ~15fps (2:1), durations agree <10ms. mp4 frame0 == first gaze sample (inferred, +-1 frame worst case; validate vs explorer GT). ffprobe mp4 fps/W per take (do not hardcode).
projection.notes: VALIDATED end-to-end on take 20230607_s1_barbara_wheeler_act1_nkg6zo: 5 frames projected onto correct targets (face/TV/table) with make_upright=true; make_upright=false is off-target. Calibration from online_calibration.jsonl ALONE works (no VRS, no metadata.json - confirmed metadata.json is not on disk). device_calibration_from_json_string does NOT accept an online-calib line; build CameraCalibration objects directly. personalized has a leading warmup gap of empty rows -> prefer general or filter empty rows.

join.comment: One csv per take in this dir; coarse ~30s spans. Text column header is literally 'Describe my activity'.
One csv per take; fine ~5s spans. Text column header is literally 'Describe my atomic actions'.

anchor.detail: gaze tracking_timestamp_us/1e6 is device clock; first gaze sample == mp4 frame 0 (gaze span 1001.006s == video 1001s). Annotations share the SAME device clock.

annotations.note: annotation start/end seconds are on the gaze device clock (anno_s ~= gaze_us/1e6); subtract the same gaze t0

metadata.notes: No metadata file. RESOLVED time-base: annotation start/end SECONDS and gaze tracking_timestamp_us are the SAME device clock, just different units — annotation_s ~= gaze_us/1e6 (verified across 3 takes: act0 gaze 5448.5..6669.1 s vs activity 5831.8..6655.96 s; act1 gaze 7846.8..8831.1 s vs 7963.4..8825.6 s; both annotation ranges sit inside the gaze range). So align by annotation_time_s * 1e6 == tracking_timestamp_us (no separate offset file needed); annotations simply start a few seconds after recording start and end before it. closed_loop_trajectory.csv also carries tracking_timestamp_us on this same clock. Gaze ~30 Hz.

provenance.notes: METADATA none. VIDEO <TAKE>/video_main_rgb/<prefix>.mp4. GAZE <TAKE>/recording_head/recording_head/recording_head/mps/eye_gaze/personalized_eye_gaze.csv (fallback general_eye_gaze.csv; not pixel-mapped, check projectaria_tools). ANNOTATION: activity summary (<TAKE>/narration_activity_summarization_csv/<prefix>.csv) and atomic action (<TAKE>/narration_atomic_action_csv/<prefix>.csv). NOTE: not all archives finished extracting; extraction running separately.
decisions: Gaze = Aria CPF (prefer personalized, fall back general); preserve full CPF columns + bounds + eye origins.
Projection feasible via projectaria_tools using on-disk online_calibration.jsonl (camera-rgb); no VRS needed.
Two annotation channels: activity_summary (~30s coarse) and atomic_action (~5s fine); text columns 'Describe my activity' / 'Describe my atomic actions'.
corrections: Gaze path is TWO recording_head levels, not three (recording_head/recording_head/mps/eye_gaze/).
File prefix is Nymeria_v0.0_<take>_<suffix> (video suffix _preview_rgb), not the bare take name -> glob within the channel dir.
personalized has a warmup gap of empty rows; general is more complete.

Time-base RESOLVED: annotation seconds == gaze microseconds / 1e6 (same device clock, not different epochs) — verified on 3 takes; align by annotation_s*1e6 == tracking_timestamp_us, no offset file needed.
